_why: Posting times, read by the daily batch (social/DAILY.md) and the walkable-five runner (pipeline/make_batch.py). Local to `timezone`; each gets a few minutes of jitter. TikTok is spread three hours apart so each video gets its own push; X and Threads post an hour apart, staggered half an hour from each other. `mode`: "schedule" posts at these times; "draft" leaves everything in Buffer as drafts.
